title: Replace hand-rolled argument parsing with clap derive
summary: Drop the env::args indexing for a #[derive(Parser)] struct, then add an optional output path.

turns.user: this cli parses args[1] by hand and its painful. switch to clap? want --help

assistant.body: Let's move to clap's derive API. The arguments become a struct, the index juggling goes away, and clap generates --help and --version for you. Doc comments turn into the help text.

turns.user: nice. also let me pick an output file. stdout if not given

assistant.body: Making it Option<PathBuf> gives you None when the flag is missing. There is no default_value_t on it, so resize decides what None means. It accepts both -o and --output.
